mapper.select: SELECT fd.fair_date_id, fd.operation_date, COUNT(eq.entry_qr_id) AS qr_issued_count, SUM(CASE WHEN eq.expires_at > NOW() AND eq.revoked_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS qr_active_count, SUM(CASE WHEN eq.revoked_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS qr_revoked_count FROM fair_dates fd LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.fair_id = fd.fair_id AND r.visit_date = fd.operation_date LEFT JOIN entry_qrs eq ON eq.reservation_id = r.reservation_id WHERE fd.fair_id = #{fairId} GROUP BY fd.fair_date_id, fd.operation_date ORDER BY fd.operation_date ASC

SELECT HOUR(enr.first_checked_in_at) AS entry_hour, COUNT(enr.entry_record_id) AS entry_count FROM entry_records enr JOIN reservations r ON r.reservation_id = enr.reservation_id WHERE enr.fair_id = #{fairId} AND r.visit_date = #{date} GROUP BY HOUR(enr.first_checked_in_at) ORDER BY entry_hour ASC

SELECT b.booth_id, bs.slot_number AS booth_number, b.name AS booth_name, COUNT(DISTINCT bv.user_id) AS unique_visitor_count, SUM(bv.visit_count) AS total_scan_count FROM booth_visits bv JOIN booth b ON b.booth_id = bv.booth_id JOIN application a ON a.application_id = b.application_id JOIN application_slot aslot ON aslot.application_id = a.application_id JOIN booth_slots bs ON bs.booth_slot_id = aslot.booth_slot_id WHERE bv.fair_id = #{fairId} GROUP BY b.booth_id, bs.slot_number, b.name ORDER BY unique_visitor_count DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM reservations WHERE fair_id = #{fairId} AND status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CHECKED_IN')

SELECT COALESCE(r.channel, '미등록') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM entry_records enr JOIN reservations r ON r.reservation_id = enr.reservation_id WHERE enr.fair_id = #{fairId} GROUP BY r.channel ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT COALESCE(u.gender, '미등록') AS label, COUNT(DISTINCT enr.user_id) AS count FROM entry_records enr JOIN users u ON u.user_id = enr.user_id WHERE enr.fair_id = #{fairId} GROUP BY u.gender ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, u.birth_date, CURDATE()) < 20 THEN '10대 이하' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, u.birth_date, CURDATE()) < 30 THEN '20대' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, u.birth_date, CURDATE()) < 40 THEN '30대' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, u.birth_date, CURDATE()) < 50 THEN '40대' ELSE '50대 이상' END AS label, COUNT(DISTINCT enr.user_id) AS count FROM entry_records enr JOIN users u ON u.user_id = enr.user_id WHERE enr.fair_id = #{fairId} GROUP BY label ORDER BY MIN(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, u.birth_date, CURDATE())) ASC

SELECT COALESCE(rp.pet_species_snapshot, '미등록') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM entry_records enr JOIN reservations r ON r.reservation_id = enr.reservation_id LEFT JOIN reservation_pets rp ON rp.reservation_id = r.reservation_id WHERE enr.fair_id = #{fairId} GROUP BY rp.pet_species_snapshot ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT ROUND(AVG(booth_count), 1) FROM ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT booth_id) AS booth_count FROM booth_visits WHERE fair_id = #{fairId} GROUP BY user_id ) sub

SELECT CONCAT(visit_depth, '개 부스') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT booth_id) AS visit_depth FROM booth_visits WHERE fair_id = #{fairId} GROUP BY user_id ) sub GROUP BY visit_depth ORDER BY visit_depth ASC

SELECT COALESCE(rp.pet_species_snapshot, '미등록') AS species, COALESCE(rp.pet_breed_snapshot, '미등록') AS breed, COUNT(*) AS count FROM entry_records enr JOIN reservations r ON r.reservation_id = enr.reservation_id LEFT JOIN reservation_pets rp ON rp.reservation_id = r.reservation_id WHERE enr.fair_id = #{fairId} GROUP BY rp.pet_species_snapshot, rp.pet_breed_snapshot ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT AVG(rp.pet_age_snapshot) FROM entry_records enr JOIN reservations r ON r.reservation_id = enr.reservation_id LEFT JOIN reservation_pets rp ON rp.reservation_id = r.reservation_id WHERE enr.fair_id = #{fairId} AND rp.pet_age_snapshot IS NOT NULL
